description: This file defines utility functions for mathematical operations, specifically 'clamp' for constraining a value within a range and 'distance' for calculating Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains the value 'v' within the bounds 'a' and 'b' using Math.max and Math.min.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance between two points 'a' and 'b' with 'x' and 'y' coordinates.

ctags.name: clamp
ctags.pattern: /^export const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));$/

ctags.name: distance
ctags.pattern: /^export const distance = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);$/
